verdict.rationale: The evidence never documents classic incoming webhooks. The closest match is Workflow Builder webhook triggers, which start a workflow from outside Slack via a URL. Separately, chat.postMessage sends messages to a channel, but it goes through the token-based Web API rather than a simple webhook URL. Getting a message into a channel this way takes a workflow setup, which is an indirect route. Missing for 10: explicit incoming-webhook documentation, evidence that a webhook URL directly posts a message to a channel, setup/payload details, and hands-on corroboration.
